card.description: A vast, cinematic sky over an ancient-tech city, where the heavens are etched with luminous glyphs and floating monoliths, blending Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs with incomprehensible crystalline hardware. The sky is a living tapestry of photorealistic clouds, bio-luminescent haze, and industrial mysticism, reflecting the grounded realism of a high-end production.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Celestial canvas spanning horizon, gradient from deep indigo to warm amber, textured with volumetric cloud layers.
**Face/Sensors:** Embedded glyphic sigils projecting faint bioluminescent patterns, responsive to ambient sound.
**Key Features:** Floating monoliths with basaltic cores, crystalline lattice spires, bio-luminescent haze, ancient script glyphs, subtle auroral ribbons.
evolution: Phase 1 (Dawn): Soft amber glow, low-lying cumulus clouds with faint glyphs, subtle bio-luminescent mist.
Phase 2 (Midday): Bright azure, high-altitude cirrus with crystalline lattice, floating monoliths casting diffused shadows.
props: Item: Floating basalt monolith with etched hieroglyphic glyphs.
Item: Crystalline lattice spire emitting soft bio-luminescent glow.
